name: duckweed
title: Duckweed Growth
subtitle: Frond count, area, relative growth rate (RGR)
description: Quantifies duckweed (aquatic plant) growth: individual frond count, total area, and RGR when comparing a time series.
method: HSV threshold → watershed → measure each frond. RGR computed as ln(Area2/Area1) / (t2-t1).
dataType: duckweed on water surface (overhead view, good contrast, no debris)
outputFormat: CSV (one row per frond, one summary row)

outputs.name: RGR
outputs.label: Relative growth rate
outputs.description: ln(Area2/Area1) / days. Requires two time points.

parameters.name: minFrondArea
parameters.label: Minimum frond area
parameters.description: Fronds smaller than this are ignored.
